title: Chopper Project JSON
description: Reproducible project-specific selection file. Captures the exact base, features, and ordering used for a trim run.

domain.description: Domain identifier. Operators are expected to invoke Chopper from the domain root, so this field is a consistency and audit identifier that must match the current working directory basename.

owner.description: Domain deployment owner for this project

release_branch.description: Git branch name for this project trim

base.description: Path to the base JSON file relative to the current working directory / domain root (forward slashes only, no '..', no '//', no absolute paths).

features.description: List of feature JSON paths in declared application order. Order is authoritative for everything (F1, F2, and F3): layers are applied left-to-right and the last layer that mentions a file/proc/step wins (R1 ordered overlay). If a feature declares `depends_on`, each prerequisite feature must also be selected and must appear earlier in this list.

notes.description: Human-readable notes explaining feature ordering or selection rationale
